checks: A never-created default inbox is a normal empty state; one deliberate click creates its folder and opens one editable note in that inbox
A previously available default inbox that disappears is reported as unavailable rather than as a new empty collection
The root file list starts within 120px of the panel top, without a repeated title, root breadcrumb, tutorial or file-count row
File filtering, clear, subfolder/up navigation and choosing a new folder work; previous files stay in place and quick-note windows receive the position change
A missing custom collection location shows recovery actions and is created only by the explicit create/write action
Actual access errors stay local with collapsed details, retry works and write failure does not create a note; the rest of the workspace stays usable
Standalone and sidebar keep opening files, six theme styles and narrow layouts; both retain the original functionality
scope: Actual App/LibraryMode/InboxView with isolated mocked native IPC; native folder semantics tested separately.
